Name: Layout Projection Mod
Author: sunus0528
Description:
[size=4][b]Description 描述[/b][/size]



将网页布局规划器的布局投影至游戏内，网页布局规划器链接：[url=https://stardew.sunus.top/][/url][url=https://stardew.sunus.top/zh]https://stardew.sunus.top/zh[/url]
Project the layout of the web page layout planner into the game environment, Web page layout planner link:[url=https://stardew.sunus.top/][/url][url=https://stardew.sunus.top/en]https://stardew.sunus.top/en[/url]将网页布局规划器投影到游戏环境中，网页布局规划器链接：https://stardew.sunus.top/en将网页布局规划器投影到游戏环境中，网页布局规划器链接：https://stardew.sunus.top/en


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]安装最新版本[/color][color=#e69138][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color][color=#ffffff]。[/color][/*]
[*]（可选）安装[color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config[/url][/color]菜单，用于配置Mod[/*]
[*]解压mod文件夹到Stardew Valley/Mods。[/*]
[*]使用SMAPI运行游戏。
[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [color=#e69138][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color].安装最新版本的SMAPI。安装最新版本的SMAPI。[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod.（可选）“安装 ；通用Mod配置菜单”用于配置Mod。（可选）“安装 ；通用Mod配置菜单”用于配置Mod。[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.使用SMAPI运行游戏。使用SMAPI运行游戏。
[/*]
[/list][size=4]使用说明：[/size]
[list=1]
[*]本mod必须搭配[url=https://stardew.sunus.top/zh]网页布局模拟器[/url]使用[/*]
[*]首先通过布局模拟器完成布局规划，您可以自定义编辑或直接导入游戏存档[/*]
[*]在[url=https://stardew.sunus.top/]网页布局模拟器[/url]完成布局后，通过顶部菜单进行导出数据文件：导入&导出-导出mod数据[/*]
[*]导出数据文件后将下载的文件放到此mod目录下的layouts目录下，目录下可同时放置多个投影文件(这步操作必须在游戏启动前完成)[/*]
[*]进入游戏后通过快捷键[b][color=#00ff00]J[/color][/b]开启或关闭投影，快捷键[b][color=#00ff00]K[/color][/b]切换上一个布局，快捷键[b][color=#00ff00]L[/color][/b]切换下一个布局[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Instructions:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]This mod must be used in conjunction with the [url=https://stardew.sunus.top/en]web layout simulator[/url].[/*]
[*]First, complete the layout planning through the layout simulator. You can either customize and edit it or directly import the game save file.[/*]
[*]After completing the layout in the [url=https://stardew.sunus.top/en]web layout simulator[/url], use the top menu to export the data file: Import & Export - Export mod data.[/*]
[*]After exporting the data file, place the downloaded file in the layouts directory under this mod's folder. Multiple projection files can be placed in this directory simultaneously (this operation must be completed before the game starts).[/*]
[*]After entering the game, use the shortcut key [color=#00ff00][b]J[/b][/color] to turn on or off the projection, use the shortcut key [color=#00ff00][b]K[/b][/color] to switch to the previous layout, and use the shortcut key [b][color=#00ff00]L[/color][/b] to switch to the next layout.[/*]
[/list]
